verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents a self-serve path. The quickstart has you create a free UK merchant account and complete a first test payment (docs-32). Console lets users retrieve the integration's client credentials (docs-21). Official SDKs cover Node.js, Python, Java and .NET and automate request signing (docs-11, docs-24, gh-1). The extra ECDSA key-pair setup adds friction to the first call (docs-12). missing for 10: a quickstart for linking a sandbox bank account (the documented quickstart is a test payment, not a Data API account link), explicit sandbox credential self-serve steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-call.
